subject: Kickoff: Sprint 0 and Implementation Readiness for Companion Health
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Sprint 0 and Implementation Readiness for Companion Health

Hi team,

Wrapping up the deal with Companion Health (DL-2027-CH-049) — signed MSA attached and SOW v3 is the working doc. We need a tight Sprint 0 to validate integration points and get the first pilot environment ready for a week-long pilot in early Dec. I want to capture the key constraints and owners so CS can start outreach and scheduling.

Quick summary / context:
- Customer: Companion Health (mid-market, population health product)
- ARR: ~$450k annual commitment (hosted + Dedicated reserved capacity for peak hours)
- Start date desired: first week of Dec; pilot window: Dec 6–10
- Primary contact: Tara Nguyen (Head of Platform) — tara@companionhealth.com
- Procurement/PO in flight (procurement@companionhealth.com) — PO expected by 11/22

What they need from Redwood during Sprint 0:
1) SSO integration (SAML) and test IdP sandbox
2) Sample dataset ingestion flow (CSV + small S3 bucket) and retention/config validation
3) Baseline performance profile on their typical sequences (50–200 tokens, 80% short responses)
4) Security/compliance evidence: filled questionnaire attached; SOC2 scoping already discussed

Risks / open items:
- PO timing — if PO delays past 11/22 we need to push pilot + credits conversation to avoid missed expectations
- SAML attribute mapping — customer has unusual username/email mapping; may need a quick mapping doc from them
- Dedicated GPU pool sizing — ops to confirm capacity for pilot (likely 2x p4d reserved for peak bursts)

Attachments included: CompanionHealth_SOW_v3.pdf, signed_MSA.pdf, security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx

Suggested owners and next steps:
- CS owner (primary): Monica Patel — own kickoff, MOP, customer comms, and pilot success criteria
- Solutions lead: Aditya Rao — lead SSO and ingestion validation, create test vectors
- Infra/ops: Vivek Kulkarni — confirm Dedicated pool sizing, pre-provision pilot capacity, and add monitoring hooks

Action items (please confirm acceptance or reassign):
- Monica: send intro to Tara and schedule internal 30-min sync by EOD 11/16
- Aditya: prepare sample ingestion checklist and perf test plan by 11/18
- Vivek: confirm whether we can reserve burst capacity Dec 6–10 and any cost-impact notes by 11/18

I'll keep the HubSpot deal updated and will share the DocuSign signed MSA link below. Monica — taking you live as owner unless you reassign.

Thanks — Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Sprint 0 and Implementation Readiness for Companion Health

Thanks Lauren — assigning to me and I accept. Quick clarifying Qs before I reach out to Tara:
1) For pilot scope: do we need L3 support during the pilot days (Dec 6–10) or will normal support suffice?
2) Any non-standard SLA or observability window requested by the customer?
3) Who is the primary technical reviewer on the customer side (SAML wiring + ingestion)? Is that Tara or a separate engineer?

I will:
- Draft a 30-min internal sync agenda and proposed customer kickoff agenda for review (by 11/16 EOD)
- Post a shared runbook link in the thread once I have it

If PO is delayed, propose we do a pre-kickoff technical review session (no pilot traffic) to keep momentum.

Monica
--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 213-555-0244
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Sprint 0 and Implementation Readiness for Companion Health

Monica — great, thanks. Answers inline: 

> 1) L3 support during pilot days?
For the pilot week we should have an on-call L3 engineer for 4 hours overlap each day (peak usage window 10am–2pm PT). Aditya can be primary for that window.

> 2) Any non-standard SLA/observability?
They asked for 30-day retention on debug traces for initial 60 days to assist integration debugging — Ops said that is feasible but will need temporary log-bucket policy (Vivek to confirm).

> 3) Primary technical reviewer on customer side?
Tara is primary contact but engineering reviewer will be Samir Patel (samir@companionhealth.com) — Tara confirmed offline. I cc'd Tara below on the next message.

I agree on the pre-kickoff technical review if PO slips. Draft agenda attached (I'll upload to Drive). Monica: you can use the suggested owner list.

Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Sprint 0 and Implementation Readiness for Companion Health

Looping in infra notes:
- Dedicated pool: we can provision a 2x p4d burst pool for Dec 6–10, but it requires a temporary capacity reservation ticket. Cost delta ~+18% for the reservation window; confirm if finance approves or we bill as overage.
- Retention for debug traces: can enable a 30-day debug bucket scoped to the customer project; will need the customer-approved data handling addendum signed (I see the MSA covers this but confirm acceptance on PII rules)
- SAML: we have a staging IdP we can share; Aditya should request metadata and attribute map (email vs username) — I'll create the sandbox IdP creds and share link to the runbook.

I'll open CAPEX ticket for capacity and post the ticket id here by EOD. Also adding the monitoring hooks (trace markers and per-route costs) to the runbook so CS can see token-level costs during the pilot.

-Vivek

From: Tara Nguyen <tara@companionhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Sprint 0 and Implementation Readiness for Companion Health

Thanks Lauren and team — excited to get going. A few quick confirmations from our side: 
- Dec 6–10 pilot works for us; Samir will be our engineering reviewer and will join the technical review.
- SAML: our IdP team needs your SP metadata and an attribute map. Samir will send our metadata by EOD 11/18.
- We can share a sanitized sample dataset and S3 bucket credentials for the ingestion test by 11/20.
- Procurement: PO is targeted for 11/22; if there is any slippage we confirm the pre-kickoff test session approach to minimize risk.

Proposed kickoff: 30 min on 11/18 11:30am PT for a technical alignment (Monica to own scheduling). Please include the SAML sandbox link and ingestion checklist in the invite.

Thanks — Tara
